intro: Huntsman Markhor, of the village of Revantusk in the Hinterlands, names the Silvermane wolves as one of the worst dangers to the village's hunters. You are asked to turn the tables and hunt the hunters.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Many brave trolls have been lost to the harsh wilds of the Hinterlands, traveler. The Silvermane wolves are one of the biggest threats to our hunters. They lay in wait, hiding amongst the bushes and landscape, then strike out when the opportunity presents itself.
This type of ferocity will not go unchecked!
You must think like the Silvermane. Stalk the stalkers! Slay them all!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Show them the might of Revantusk!

clips.title: Completion
paras: A job well done, traveler. The Revantusk thank you for your contribution.
